freeze.note: This campaign is bound to exactly one implementation SHA, the one the confirmatory freeze pinned. The binding is mechanical rather than procedural: the checker re-reads the freeze record, recomputes its SHA-256, decodes it through the production decoder, and drives the production admission surface with a different git horizon to prove the mismatch refusal. Spec 3.1:148 - confirmatory evidence never spans two implementation SHAs.

No sealed hidden oracle exists. Spec 3.1:151-153 requires oracles sealed before the freeze and validated by at least two independent annotators; the freeze records no annotator facts, by governor ruling comment-fd14351d, and none were invented here.

Spec :241 requires two raters and one adjudicator, all independent of the Moe implementation team, with affiliations published in the manifest. The freeze carries no affiliation field and no rater or adjudicator identity. Inventing one would invent research provenance, which every ruling on this lane forbids.
No user-study case was instantiated. G-L4-userstudy is defined relationally at :383 against a benchmark gate direction that is itself UNKNOWN here.

censoringNote: CENSORING WAS NOT USED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. Administrative censoring classifies a unit that started and did not finish. It cannot classify a unit that was never instantiated, and using it that way would turn censoring into a wastebasket for absent evidence. Spec :306 rule 4 separately puts AGENT FAILURE - including a run terminated at tau while awaiting a decision command beyond the frozen human-assistance script, the G-J1 stall case - explicitly OUTSIDE administrative censoring, so that a system demanding unscripted human input cannot vanish into it. Zero units are recorded as censored under any rule; every unit family is recorded as NOT_INSTANTIATED, which is missing evidence, which is UNKNOWN and never PASS.
